description: This file defines the ControlChannel class and related data structures for managing communication and connection state within the OpenClaw application. It handles establishing connections, sending requests, processing events, and managing connection health for control channels, including remote and local modes.

classes.name: ControlChannel
classes.description: A singleton class managing the control communication channel, connection states, and associated events within the app.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the control channel, optionally in remote mode.

methods.name: refreshEndpoint
methods.description: Reconnects or refreshes the control endpoint based on the reason provided.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current control endpoint and resets relevant states.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Performs a health check on the control connection, returning data or throwing an error.

methods.name: lastHeartbeat
methods.description: Retrieves the last heartbeat event received from the server.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request to the control gateway with specified method and parameters.

methods.name: sendSystemEvent
methods.description: Sends a system event message with optional parameters.

methods.name: startEventStream
methods.description: Initializes and manages the incoming push notification stream.
